account_id.description: The agent's NOVA account ID; must match the account configured in the extension setup.

group_id.description: The NOVA group holding the file. The account must be a member.

cid.description: The file's storage location, as returned by store_file or listed by list_group_files.

encoding.description: How to return the content: utf8 (default, for text) or base64 (for binary files).
